# redash_group_data_sources (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "redash_group_data_sources" "default" {
  group_id = 2
}

output "default_data_sources" {
  value = data.redash_group_data_sources.default.data_sources
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) ID of the group.

### Read-Only

- `data_sources` (List of Object) Data sources granted to the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_sources))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--data_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_sources`

Read-Only:
